headline: Data Analytics | SQL - Tableau - Power BI - dbt - Snowflake - Dashboards & Data Validation
summary: Data analytics professional with 6+ years turning big data (large, complex datasets) into business insights the business acts on. Currently a Senior Business Analyst at Northwind Retail Group with deep hands-on experience in SQL, Tableau, Power BI, MicroStrategy, Snowflake, and dbt, partnering with IT and business stakeholders from requirements through UAT sign-off. Completing an M.S. in Computer Science with an AI concentration (expected June 2027).

bullets.text: Surfaced that 1 in 4 products barely sell and that organic items outperform their shelf allocation by 2-3x. Designed the prompting and validation approach so every model-surfaced pattern was checked against source data before informing a recommendation.
Built an end-to-end Python big data analysis pipeline over 12.4M+ retail transactions, using Claude for LLM-assisted exploration at a scale conventional querying cannot reach.
Modeled how a price cut on the best-selling item would affect sales, using published pricing benchmarks.

Built a multi-agent system as an explicit LangGraph state machine with planner, researcher, critic, and writer agents. Added supervisor routing and a bounded revision cycle that returns failed reviews for more evidence.
Wrote a 18-assertion evaluation harness and 30 unit tests gating termination, citation coverage, and policy compliance.
Translate ambiguous business requirements into technical specifications, partnering with IT to build the datasets, cubes, and data reporting pipelines that serve them and meet SLAs.
Write SQL and MDX to map and validate data structures across large reporting systems, then present designs for approval before building in production.
Lead new reporting pilots end-to-end in MicroStrategy and Excel/SSAS, owning the full test cycle of approach, scenarios, and scripts. Drive UAT through to sign-off.
Manage delivery like a project by running stakeholder meetings, applying problem-solving to data-validation fixes, and escalating blockers to leadership.
Cut dashboard load time by 75% for 40+ users by rebuilding a slow Tableau dashboard at the data source level.
Built Tableau dashboards that 15+ regions relied on for real-time visibility into market share and pricing trends across Nielsen and internal sales data.
Applied problem-solving with Python, SQL, Snowflake, and dbt to troubleshoot and reconcile data quality issues before they reached leadership.
Translated business requirements into dashboard specs for major retail accounts across grocery, club, and e-commerce channels.
Wrote queries to catch data errors across large reporting systems, protecting data quality for audit reconciliations.
Diagnosed why audit cases stalled in review and documented common causes to improve backlog processing times.
